Use case: illustration-story. Asset: FOUR SCENES of a Korean female-chibi historical COMIC BOOK for Baekje prologue. Use supplied reference 1 for EXACT character identity (four columns, row-major); reference 2 for fully illustrated comic art style and staging ONLY. DO NOT recreate Silla people or yellow uniforms from style reference. Characters all adult WOMEN with three-head-tall chibi proportions. Gye: navy twin braids, violet eyes, gentle round face, blue-gold armor. Yunchung: long high navy ponytail, fierce blue eyes, blue-gold commander armor. Heukchi Sangji: warm dark brown skin, golden eyes, high long ponytail, big gold hoop earrings, lively grin. Boksin: short dark blue tousled hair, violet eyes, angular brows, blue armor, stubborn brave expression. Chungsang: long straight teal-blue hair, blue headband, green eyes, calm worried expression, archer kit. Uija is the female crowned Baekje ruler, dark formal updo, navy-gold royal robes.
Warm brown ink outlines, rich hand-painted 2D anime cel shading, expressive comic facial acting and body language, detailed Korean architecture and clothing, blue Baekje military flags and blue-gold armor. No 3D, photorealism, pixels or Japanese motifs.
EXACT 2x2 grid with FOUR equal landscape cells, vertical and horizontal cuts precisely at 50%. Overall landscape 3:2. No outer border or gutters (viewer will supply page borders). Each cell is a FULL DRAWN NARRATIVE ILLUSTRATION, never portraits floating on a shared palace background or a lineup of character cards. Draw actual physical interactions, distinct environments and props specified. Keep all character FACES mainly in the lower 60 percent of each cell; upper 30 percent of each cell is detailed uncluttered sky/wall/tent background available for HTML dialogue. No text, letters, speech balloons, numbers, labels, UI or watermark. Do not add unlisted named characters or duplicate figures. FIVE when specified means exactly five total.
TOP LEFT scene 1: Baekje dawn forward camp, Gye gently serving rice from an iron pot as Yunchung arrives with a rolled dispatch, cheerful but tense before a campaign.
TOP RIGHT scene 2: Yunchung grandly arranging wooden troop markers and a reversed blue flag at a low table, Gye smiling and quietly turning the flag upright.
BOTTOM LEFT scene 3: Exactly FIVE women generals gather around a low breakfast camp table: Gye, Yunchung, Heukchi Sangji, Boksin and Chungsang. Establish each as a distinct woman interacting, not a lineup of portraits.
BOTTOM RIGHT scene 4: Heukchi Sangji kneels to oil a stuck wooden supply cart wheel; Gye gently bandages the mechanic's scratched hand. Warm affectionate non-romantic comedy.
